income_tax.note: No tax on wages, retirement-account withdrawals, or pensions.

capital_gains_excise.unit: WA long-term capital gains excise tax: standard deduction $, then threshold $ / total marginal rate % above it
capital_gains_excise.note: 7% on WA long-term capital gains above the standard deduction; an additional 2.9% (9.9% combined) applies above $1,000,000 of gain (flat, not inflation-indexed). Applies identically regardless of filing status -- no single/MFJ split. Retirement-account withdrawals and real estate sales are explicitly exempt. 2026 standard deduction not yet published by WA DOR at research time; $278,000 (2025) used as most recent confirmed.

social_security.note: No state income tax exists, so Social Security is not taxed.

retirement_income.note: No income tax; and IRA/401(k)/pension withdrawals are also explicitly carved out of the capital gains excise tax.

senior_tax_credits.note: No income tax exists to give a break against.

effective_rate_pct.unit: % of home value/year, statewide avg effective rate

property_tax.relief_programs_note: Senior Citizens/Disabled Persons Property Tax Exemption (RCW 84.36.381): age 61+ (or retired due to disability); tiered exemption from regular and/or excess levies based on combined disposable income, with thresholds set per county (e.g. King County 2025 threshold $88,998). Separate Deferral Program (age 60+) lets seniors defer property tax payment, accruing 5% simple annual interest, repaid at sale/death/transfer. Both are county-specific and/or income-tested -- not applied to the estimate below.
